text: Riso Kagaku Corporation's major shareholders (top five) as of 31 March 2026 are RISO Limited (15.71%), the Riso Educational Foundation (8.46%), Akatsuki Kosan Co., Ltd. (6.22%), The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 5.99%) and a Mizuho retirement-benefit trust re-entrusted to Custody Bank of Japan (4.98%).
short: Riso Kagaku's top holders as of 31 March 2026: RISO Limited 15.71%, Riso Educational Foundation 8.46%, Akatsuki Kosan 6.22%.
